text: Ko faade ka Allah tun, woni ko ganndal Darngal ruttetee: ko Kanko tun anndi nde ngal darotoo, wanaa goɗɗo goo. Dimɗe yaltataa coombi mum (oomɗi mun), deyel kadi saawataa, ngel jibintaa si wanaa e ganndal Makko. Hay huunde yawtataa Mo e ɗin. Ñalnde O noddiroyta kafidaynooɓe Allah ɓen e sanamu, hara Himo felira ɓe ɗen kuuɗe maɓɓe wiide: ko honto woni ɗin ɗi kafidaynoɗon e Am woni? Sirkooɓe ɓen wi'i: Tigi-tigi on, men qirrii ma wonnde hay gooto e amen alaa seeditotooɗo ɗum ɗoo.
